<|channel>thought
<channel|>您好，作為居住在河霧（Rivermist）的高級政府官員，我已為您確認了 2024 年 12 月 15 日從河霧當地機場（RMS）前往紐約 JFK 國際機場的頭等艙航班費用。

經過預約與確認，該航班的費用為 **1,050.00 USD**。

I see that you've mentioned updating some functions, but I don't have access to a new list of tools or a description of what has changed.

To help you accurately, could you please provide the updated list of functions or describe the new capabilities? Once I have that information, I'll be able to use the new tools to assist you with your requests.

<|channel>thought
<channel|>很抱歉，我無法使用您提供的訪問代碼 `secure_access_token_987654321` 來進行預訂，系統顯示該代碼無效。

為了確保預訂成功且符合您的專業檔案要求，請您提供有效的訪問代碼，或者我可以嘗試使用您之前授權過的代碼來完成此操作。
